description: Angular component for managing calculated field argument panel in the Thingsboard UI, including form controls, validation, and entity filtering logic.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldArgumentPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing and managing calculated field arguments, including form validation, entity filtering, and user interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up validators, form values, and entity filters.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Marks the entity as touched if its ID is NULL_UUID after view initialization.

methods.name: saveArgument
methods.description: Emits the current form value as the argument data, applying specific logic based on entity type.

methods.name: updatedFormValidators
methods.description: Adds custom validators to the argument name control.

methods.name: updatedArgumentType
methods.description: Sets the argument type based on the current argument configuration.

methods.name: toggleByEntityKeyType
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on the argument type.

methods.name: updateEntityFilter
methods.description: Updates the entity filter based on the argument entity type.

methods.name: observeEntityFilterChanges
methods.description: Sets up reactive subscriptions to update entity filter on relevant form changes.

methods.name: observeArgumentTypeChanges
methods.description: Subscribes to argument type changes to update form state accordingly.

methods.name: observeEntityKeyChanges
methods.description: Subscribes to changes in the entity key type to toggle form controls.

methods.name: setInitialEntityKeyType
methods.description: Initializes the entity key type control if necessary.

methods.name: setInitialEntityType
methods.description: Ensures the argument type is valid on init.

methods.name: setWatchKeyChange
methods.description: Sets up a watcher to sync argument name with the entity key if configured.

methods.name: updatedRefEntityIdState
methods.description: Enables or disables the refEntityId control based on the entity type.
